verdict.rationale: A hands-on probe fetched https://docs.cekura.ai/openapi.json with HTTP 200, and the file contains an "openapi" key, so a machine-readable spec is publicly downloadable. The structured API reference pages (e.g., send-calls, create-api-key) match a spec-backed reference. Missing for 10: first-party documentation that advertises or describes the spec download (location, version, coverage of all endpoints).
